Class KinematicCharacterController

SolveRigidBodyMovements

Determines if the character should solve the movements caused by rigidbodies stood upon. If enabled, the character will sweep the movements, this is less performant and less stable but will cause less potential collision issues. If disabled, the character will not sweep the movements, this is more performant and more stable but will cause more potential collision issues.

[EditorDisplay("RigidBody interactions", null)]
[EditorOrder(501)]
public bool SolveRigidBodyMovements { get; set; }

Returns collider collided with by the cast, if any. Will filter if collision filtering is enabled for this character.

OverlapCollider(Vector3, out Collider[], uint, PhysicsFlag)

Return all colliders we are overlapping with in an array. Will filter if collision filtering is enabled for this character. Array is also sorted in an unordered sequence where all valid colliders are at the beginning of the array, and all invalid colliders are at the end of the array.

public int OverlapCollider(Vector3 origin, out Collider[] colliders, uint layerMask = 4294967295, PhysicsFlag flags = PhysicsFlag.None)

TraceGround(out RayCastHit, out GroundFlag)

Do a ground trace cast, considering if the ground is stable. Automatically makes a cast with the distance of GroundingDistance + KinematicContactOffset if not HasSolidBelow, or with the distance of GroundingDistance + StairStepDistance + KinematicContactOffset if HasSolidBelow.
